ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closed Lost"), ISCHANGED(Stage__c), Not( OR( ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, 'Deferred'), ISPICKVAL(LatestQuote__r.Status__c, 'Rejected'))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity can only be marked as 'Closed Lost' if the associated Quote is in 'Deferred' or 'Rejected.' Please update the Quote status before proceeding.
